changes: Highground now uses midnight blue, gold and ivory inspired by its crest, with the same look across all six addons.
Class colors identify players across combat rows, known carriers, journals, class macro recipes and observed bounty targets. Target, focus and attack cues stay distinct.
Highground is the default theme. Class Colors offers stronger tinting; saved theme, font, opacity and layout choices are kept.
Health lines stay readable with custom class colors and fade when health is unknown.
notice: Restart WoW after updating to load the new crest texture. Choose Highground in your addon’s theme picker; in Highground, you can also use /hg theme highground. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
